scripts.protocol:build: wsl bash -c "cd tsn && npm run protocol:build"
scripts.protocol:deploy: wsl bash -c "cd tsn && npm run protocol:deploy"
scripts.protocol:test: wsl bash -c "cd tsn && npm run protocol:test"
scripts.dev:run:all: echo "Run each command in a separate terminal:" && echo "Terminal 1: npm run dev:run:backend" && echo "Terminal 2: npm run dev:run:frontend"
scripts.git:pull-all: git pull origin main && git submodule update --init --recursive
scripts.git:commit-push-all: git add -A && git commit -m "Update submodules" && git push --recursive origin main
scripts.git-commit-push: git diff-index --quiet HEAD || (git add . && git commit -m "Something just got updated!" --allow-empty && git push origin main)
scripts.git-commit-push-force: git add . && git commit -m "Something just got updated!" --no-verify --allow-empty && git push origin main --force
